_comment: Source of truth for the auto-generated repository catalog in README.md. The Action in .github/workflows/repo-catalog.yml lists every public repo, classifies it, and regenerates the catalog. A repo NOT listed under `repos` is classified automatically: GitHub topic `cat-<id>` first, then keyword scoring over name, description, topics and README, then the `new` bucket. Edit here, never in the generated SVGs or between the CATALOG markers in README.md.
